verdict.rationale: Drata's own API documents controls mapped to framework requirements, with 'List Requirements for Control', 'Reset Control Requirement Mappings' and 'Compare Control Requirements' endpoints, plus multiple frameworks ('List Frameworks', 'List Framework Requirements'). This implies a native control-to-requirement mapping layer, but the evidence is endpoint names only. Nothing shows SOC 2 work automatically counting toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA, or the overlap being displayed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-framework control/evidence reuse, named SOC 2/ISO 27001/HIPAA mappings, automatic crediting of shared controls, an overlap view or UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown
